avis.texte: Its really hard to find products for darker skin. This product makes your skin feel so good and hydrated. I also see a difference in my pores and helping with the texture.
Excellent exfoliation that will clear off the dead skin cells, and some of the wrinkles, for a younger face and smoother hands.
I never let myself run out. Perfect when you cannot get in for a facial. Regular use keeps my skin texture more even and bright.
Been using this for years, a gentle an effective exfoliant to use a time or two per week.
Using this wash several times a week has helped tackle milia bumps - which are really hard to get rid of. I'm a fan!!

I have used this produce several times now (every 2 to 3 days) on my face, neck and chest area. It is a wonderful, gentle exfoliating product. I follow with their avocado mask. Since stating this routine I have had several compliments on my "beautiful skin". These steps leave my skin looking smooth and glowy.
Love it I have two one for my travel bag too I use it with my mia for more exfoliation
Great product. I use it 2-3 times a week for a fresh face feeling.
I love this scrub - I use it about twice per week but it seems gentle enough to use every day. I love how smooth my skin feels after using it with no redness or sensitivity.

avis.titre: Just a couple of minutes away from fresh face!
avis.texte: I was amazed by how just a tiny drop of product did such a great job of micro-dermabrasion!

The perfectly intense scrub that keeps my skin glowing. I use this once per week, sometimes twice depending what my skin needs. And it just takes that extra layer of grime off so my skin feels fresh and new again!
Love every ear so much with this product! Leaves my skin feeling incredibly smooth

I use many of the Kiehls products and wanted to add this to my regime based on the reviews. Unfortunately it was way to harsh for my skin and left it red and feeling raw, bought this on a bogo and am stuck with two tubes of product I'll never use. For reference, I don't necessarily have sensitive skin.

I've been a loyal user of this product for a couple years now. The product has little scent, lathers nicely, and has a strong scrub that naturally clears away dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and gives your best layer of skin a chance to shine. I'm 54, so this helps reveal my best skin and gives it a glow. I use it a couple times a week, and it always brightens up my face. Have recommended to lots of friends - one of my favorite Kiehl products. Love it.
Great stuff makes the skin feel new and refreshed always use this stuff to replenish the skin
This did absolutely nothing for my skin, I even took before and after photos. So expensive for nothing
I love this product. Always gets rid of the rough, dead skin and brightens up my face, and doesn't leave any redness or residue.

avis.titre: A little sloughing helps a lot!
avis.texte: Switched to Kiehls from another brand, does a nice job exfoliating a few times a week. Definitely notice the difference immediately. Highly recommend.

I have tried a similar product from goop - the glow scrub. This product is a fraction of the price and works just as well, if not better. Makes my skin feel nicely scrubbed and ready to absorb product.
Absolutely love this product. I keep it in the shower and use a pea size amount to exfoliate and cleanse my face and neck.
Super quality exfoliant that I use 2x week. My adolescent skin issues make this product very necessary in my routine
Excellent exfoliation, not overly rough, but also doesn't strip. Just want it to do a little more for my rough bumpy oily skin.
Great way to gently remove the dead skin layer and gives a refreshing shine. Great lather!
Wonderful product. Makes your skin feel soft and healthy. A must for your routine.
About 2 times a wk I use. Not harsh. Makes I face look so clean and bright. Love this
Love this product! Makes your skin bright and smooth. Exfoliating is a breeze with this.
This is a great product. I use it twice a week. It's too hard on my sensitive chest skin, but I use it on my face and neck. It preps my skin nicely for my products.

avis.titre: Great product to make your skin smooth and shiny
avis.texte: Great product to clean and smooth your skin. For sensitive skin little to no pressure should be applied when applying to skin.

This is my new thing. I love Kiehls and decided to give this product a try. This is definitely going on my must have list. I don't know yet if it will make a lot of difference in my skin but so far I really enjoy using it!
This is probably my favorite Kiehls product. Your skin actually looks smoother and more youthful after use.
This stuff is amazing. It clears off dead skin cells, shrinks pores, reduces wrinkles, and melts off the tops of blackheads. I use it daily.
Once a week, in the shower before you wash your hair. For me it would be too drying to do more than that, but I have very dry skin.
Love this product! I use about 2-3 times per week and it makes my skin feel so soft and smooth.
First exfoliator that actually works I didn't like the way my skin looked right after using this it looked irritated which is why I took one star but the next day my skin was radiant.

Not a harsh microdermabrasion product. I use it in the shower - twice a week works for me but I think if I needed to use it more often, I wouldn't damage my skin. Also, you don't need a lot to make a difference. My skin feels wonderfully smooth -& I've noticed a difference in the texture.
This is the best at removing dry dead skin and keeps me from getting pimples.
Skin texture is more even after every use. Not as harsh as the Apricot Scrubs from other companies

avis.titre: Does a lot but not quite enough
avis.texte: My skin feels so smooth and baby soft after using this AS DIRECTED. Pls read the directions bc, as someone who has over-exfoliated, I'm begging you not to over-microdermabrasion. That sounds terrifying. Anyway, this is a wonderful product. The only thing that takes a star away is that the pores on my nose still look clogged when I apply makeup, which was the main reason I bought this product. So it's great but doesn't seem to help me achieve my main goal.
hesitant at first due to the price and size of the bottle, but I for sure will be always be using this in my weekly routine!
I use this just once a week and it polishes my skin perfectly without being over drying.

I needed a scrub to incorporate to my skin routine and I was recommended this by a family member and wow I love this stuff. I love how your skin feels so soft after. You can't go wrong with this product.
I'm always looking for a great exfoliant scrub for my "mature" skin (over 65), and I think I've found one to always have on hand. Love Kiehl's, and this is a new fave.

I am a 53 year old female and I started using this product a couple of months ago. I cannot believe the difference it has made on my skin texture. I used to get milia cysts on my face all the time and in only a couple of weeks they were all gone. I am so sold on this product! Excellent results without going to the dermatologist.
Best exfoliater on the market. Cliniques work pretty well but the Kiehls is best.
Face feels much cleaner, smoother, and pores look smaller than previously. Love this product!

avis.titre: Excellent addition to skin care routine
avis.texte: I definitely note a difference in my skin's clarity and minimal breakouts with consistent use. My face is much brighter and smoother when using 2-3 times per week.
This is amazing! Best exfoliating product I have ever used. Non-irritating and extremely effective.

I have been using this very product since 2011. I was intruded to it by a former boss. She had the most beautiful glowing skin, and I had to have it. I use this 1-2 times weekly with my Michael Todd Sonic Cleaning Tool. I use the Ultra Face Cleanser and Moisturizer, and NOTHING ELSE. I constantly get compliments from people. I have probably turned 100 people on to this product.
I love these little sand like grains in this light facial scrub. It takes the top layer of old skin off leaving your face refreshed and feeling new! I use this once a month at the least!
This had irregular chunks I found abrasive. It felt awful on skin with poor results.

avis.titre: My skin feels great after using this
avis.texte: I found this product easy to use and it works well with my acne prone skin. It doesn't have an odor. I figured out that when it says to use with a damp face, that doesn't mean wet, it means juuuust slightly damp. The product runs a little dry but that's easily remedied with a little water. That's probably why the directions say damp face.
I'm 60,i use ever other day, helps with lines. trying to reduce age spots on my face

I very rarely write reviews for products unless I am seriously impressed. I tried this scrub for the first time today and I am SOLD. My skin felt so much smoother and vibrant after just one treatment. It is worth every penny and some. You will not be disappointed.
My face felt so soft after using this for the first time today. Removed dead skin that I didn't even realize I had. Plan on using it at least once a week going forward. Super effective!
This has very sharp chunks that scratches face. I wouldn't even use this to sand my floors. Especially at this ridiculous price.
very aggressive, you can feel the dead skin or whatever it is coming off. Do not scrub too long, will take you down too many layers!

I rinse my face with warm water and then use a very small amount of the scrub on my face and throat, avoiding the eye area. Since using it (one week) a scaly patch that has plagued me for moths is gone!

I've only used this product 3 times and I already notice that my skin is clearer. It leaves my skin feeling so clean. Going to purchase a couple more as this product does sell out. A must have in your skin care routine!
Blown away. Used several different scrubs over the years- low cost to high cost. This wins. A lot goes a long way. Be gentle and your skin will thank you.

Consistency is perfect - really effective without being too rough. I keep this in the shower and use it whenever I feel like I need to slough off dead skin or shrink more pores. I have combination skin and use the Calendula cleanser.

This exfoliant has the perfect grit. It?s very small and does an amazing job of exfoliating, without being too abrasive or harsh. Many other products I?ve tried have been either too harsh, or don?t do enough. This is the right balance. I?m So so happy I found this product. It?s a gentle but deep exfoliant.

This is my ultimate favorite among Kiehl?s products! I used it 3x a week and see instant results. My skin glows instantly and achieve the rosy cheek effect! Love it! No wonder it?s always out of stock because it really works! Please do not discontinue!

avis.titre: My skin has never been smoother
avis.texte: I use this 2 or 3 times a week in the shower and I absolutely love it. I feel like my skin has never been smoother. I use this along with the entire Calendula line as part of my normal skin care routine.

avis.titre: A Little Goes a Long Way
avis.texte: I?ve used Kiehls products for many years as I?ve always been disappointed when trying another brand. I have thought about trying this often, but found it was always out of stock when I wanted to try it. I was finally able to purchase it and understand firsthand the rave reviews. You just need a tiny bit to get rid of dead skin and to achieve a healthy glow. Though it feels silky and the abrasive particles are tiny, they are powerful. After use, my skin feels clean, soft and looks radiant. Very happy with it!

Dear Microdermabrasion, I don?t know what I ever did without you! And I know we will never break up! I haven?t had skin this soft since I was a baby. I feel so refreshed and my face has a glow that made my mother ask if I was in love. I said yes...of course! Yours Truly

For everyone wondering this product is NOT discountinued! They had to place item on back order due to a high demand. They are currently projecting the product to be back on the sales floor by mid to end of October!

avis.titre: Throw away that apricot scrub! Get this if you can!
avis.texte: I will admit... I'm one of those people that has been using Apricot scrub for over 25 years... it's a force of habit...and my skin just doesn't feel clean if I don't use it.... despite knowing that most aestheticians/dermatologists would lock me up for using it... We've all been told that it's too harsh and is really bad for our skin... I know..I know... I walked into Kiehls a few weekends back and received this Mirco -Dermabrasion scrub sample.... I used it that night and was completely blown away.... As a woman of colour...with combination skin.. and a few spots that need fading.... this product truly impressed me! I felt like I had an entire new face...without having a facial...I've been trying to order this online and track it down in our stores..without success... I really hope this product does not become discontinued....as it's wonderful... As a first time Kiehls user... this is what will keep me coming back... now if only we can find it! If you can get your hands on this... you won't regret it!

avis.titre: This is the only exfoliating experience I want!
avis.texte: This product is one of the best I when ever tried! The texture is prefect it rinses away easily and I have control over the exfoliating based on how much pressure I apply. It makes it easy to avoid over exfoliating sensitive spots. PLEASE KEEP UO WITH DEMAND! Can?t get it anymore anywhere ever!!!!!

avis.titre: but why is it ALWAYS out of stock?!?
avis.texte: It seems that every time I look for it, it is "out of stock." This has been going on for months.

Knowing the quality of other Kiehl's products, I decided to try their Micro-Dermabrasion product. Instanly, when I applied it to my face, I could tell it was working. It's got a nice "grit" to it and after I finished and washed it off, my skin has never felt so smooth and soft. This is truly amazing and will definitely use it twice a week to keep my skin looking it's best. Thank you, Kiehl's.

This is a great product to use at least once a week. Goes on well and washes off with no residue. Used once a week this is a great item to use to brighten skin . This is the second time I have purchased this product and I have recommended it to others.

I use this a couple times a week and it keeps my skin looking SMOOTH. I especially love how the Ultra Facial Cream really soaks in nicely after I use this product. A little goes a long way and the bottle lasts me about 6 months using it 1 to 2 times per week. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: My Face Feels Smoother Than A Piglets Bottom!
avis.texte: Exfoliating my skin with this product has made a huge difference in the way my face looks and feels. After a few uses, I could definitely see a difference with the texture and fine lines. My makeup goes on smoother and people at work tell me that I'm glowing. My husband loves it too. It makes his bald head look smooth and sexy. Also, great for exfoliating my neck and chest area too. I highly recommend this product...and as the saying goes, "a little dab will do ya!"

There's something about the texture of this that makes it do the job better than any other exfoliant I've used. I normally wouldn't want to spend this much money on an exfoliant when you can just make stuff with ingredients you have at home. But it just makes my face soooo soft and smooth unlike anything else. I use it 2 or 3 times/week. I can't go without it.
This is the absolute best dermabrasion product I have ever used!!I won't buy anything else. My skin feels so smooth and clean after using.

Omg I just received this item in the mail and tried it for the first time after I took off my make up with the midnight recovery cleansing oil and the grains in the paste were so soft for some reason I thought they were gonna be bigger/rougher grains but I liked it! I?m looking to improve the texture and remove some light acne marks on the sides of my face and I?m going to use this product 2-3 times per week and I?m excited to see the results and I hope this product is worth the price! I followed the microderm paste with Kiehls bio peel to get rid of dark spots. I recently switched all my products to Kiehls products because my mom recommended to stop wasting money on cheap drug store products that don?t work and I?m happy so far!

I have piled on all kinds of moisturizers in the winter trying to rid my face of a flaky forehead. I think I was making it worse. FINALLY i found a product that gets rid of it. I use it 3x a week and alternate it w/ another brand's enzyme peeling cream. I follow up w/ the Skin Rescuer which I also love. My winter skin hasn't felt this soft and been this flake-free since I was a teenager! It does feel a little sandy but I rather like the texture as I can feel it working. I also do feel like it has helped lessen the look of my forehead lines.
I dare to assure that there is no better exfoliant in the world. Excellent to reduce the dark appearance of blemishes on the face.

avis.titre: It's not worth it as it has no effect at all
avis.texte: I purchased and used this product a month ago. I used it every other day. It has no effect at all: it did not minimize discolorations and small marks on my face and hands. I shared this product with my daughter. It has no effect as well.
I received a sample in my last order of this. What a nice product!! Wow! Came on to check it out but I cannot justify the price.

I wanted to wait a month to write this, but couldn't wait to share my review after using it for about 2-3 weeks. I saw extremely fast improvements & results for my post acne red & rolling scars that I thought I was going to be cremated with. I use it in conjunction with the Clearly Corrective Clarity-Activating Toner & Dermatologist Solutions Clearly Corrective Brightening & Smoothing Moisture Treatment. (I have tough skin.) My scars went from dark red to light pink and my rolling scars are less visible. I have wasted hundreds of dollars and hours researching, reading reviews, & trying other products that do not work. My only regret is not looking to Kiehls sooner.

I received this as a sample and I had to buy it. It's like taking my daily scrub to a new level and honestly creating a fresh look. I use it only once a week and it has dramatically improved age spots and sun damage as well as PMS acne. But for those with sensitive skin like mine, please note I do look pretty red and feel dry skin for about 12-24 hours after use.

I LOVE this stuff. I use twice per week and have seen amazing results thus far. You know those horrid, blackhead-looking things that appear on and around your nose? Odds are, they probably aren't blackheads. They are, instead, what are called sebaceous filaments (google it) made from sebum, a human-made product that ruins my life. If you don't know what I'm talking about, I envy you and your porcelain, flawless skin. Anyway, I have tried like mad, for years to get rid of mine, because I, like most people who have skin, don't like the appearance or feeling of clogged pores. I've been using this for a solid month and my pores look SO MUCH BETTER. Before I was insecure. Now I arrogantly walk around like I were born without pores. Just kidding. But I do feel more confident when people get close to my face...for whatever reason. AND ANOTHER THING! Exfoliating, for those of you unaware, is a process by which one removes dead skin and other nastiness from their skin's surface. Epidermal Re-Texturizing Micro-Dermabrasion exfoliates AND does microscopic damage (dermabrasion) to your skin's surface thereby increasing collagen production, reducing fine lines and wrinkles, improving appearance (or lack thereof) of pores, etc. Think laser surgery but way less drastic...and easier. Use this followed by vitamin c serum and a moisturizer, twice per week, before you go to bed. You'll wake up feeling like a skincare queen or king *drops mic*

I love this fine micro! As we all have spent 1000's of dollars over the years, I finally found something that gives somewhat progress for my tuff skin. Large pores, acne and chicken pox marks. No way a miracle (there isn't one) but I use most mornings in the shower and my skin tolerates. So, I recommend..
I got this as a gift and it makes my skin feel so soft and renewed. I've tried other scrubs but I think I've found my one and only.

Very very effective and awesome, best exfoliating formula in the whole world. This product worked so amazing for my combination Oily skin.....I am now hooked to this, I use this 2X/weekly! will continue purchasing!

I just recently switched all my skin care products to Kiehl's. I am loving all of them but this exfoliator is almost MAGIC! Use a very light touch, I don't have sensitive skin, so the first time I used it, I used a bit too much pressure, and ended up with some redness that lasted a couple of days. I let my skin rest for 5 days before using again, and then used a very light touch. This time the magic happened. My skin felt so clean, so smooth, and the products I applied after, sunk right into my skin. I will use this 2-3 times per week, with a light touch and I think it will be great for my 52 year old skin. For years, I've been guilty of going to bed with makeup on, smoking, and generally not taking great care of my skin, I've tried LOTS of products, looking for the miracle to happen, Kiehl's is the closest I have come to products that really work!!

This is going to be Kiehl's most abrasive facial scrub. You'll only want to use this product once or twice a week, no more than that. Works best with Centella Recovery Skin Salve used after to protect the skin. You'll also want to make sure your skin is moist before use and when you apply it, use as little force as you can as you don't want to do more damage than good. Can also lighten the appearance of dark spots on the skin. Also: Absolutely stay away from the eye area, no exceptions.
The best scrub ever - works perfectly - not one of those coarse apricot pit scrubs -it is overpriced

I was sent a sample of this with my last order. I had not planned on spending any more money on my face this month, but this stuff is holy grail. I could not believe how velvety soft it made my skin, and my moisturizer seemed to seep into the skin much more effectively. I have tried MANY exfoliators, but NONE of them worked like this. And, I swear, my wrinkles were improved when I woke up this morning and I've only used it once (last night). I just bought the full size, and broke my promise to my self not to spend any more money, because the results are truly nothing short of incredible.

I purchased this product after researching online. Two weeks of using this product and the results are less than expected. I received better results of sloughing away dead skin from a basic scrub from Target. Don't bother with this product.
I absolutely love this product. I use it about once a week and my skin is smoother, my make up goes on better and I look great. This is the best exfoliant out there.

avis.titre: Like having a professional facial at home
avis.texte: I use this once a week (unless I've run out) as part of my at home facial. Leaves skin feeling smooth as a baby's butt for days to come. One of my all time favorite Kieh'ls products. Doesn't over dry, extremely effective at sloughing off dead skin with out leaving skin feeling irritated. I have normal skin with a dry patch between my eyebrows that is not super sensitive, but a little sensitive. Highly recommend.

II'm 28 y.o. My skin is oily, sensitive and have a big pores. So I use this Micro-Dermabrasion 2 timer per week and love it. My skin feeling soft, but what more important for me: the pores looks clean and smaller. I really like this, I use it like a regular scrub. Use a little bit and do not press on the skin.

I'm a 22 year-old guy. I became a little obsessed about my skin as a teenager and trying everything to make it less oily, clear from acne, more even tone, yada yada. About a year ago, I wanted to try exfoliating with a quality product; all the scrubs I bought from the store just irritated my skin causing breakouts and the added brightness gained little appreciated between the scattered red. This product is really amazing. It's definitely expensive; I'm a senior in college, so I have to consider this an investment towards my self-esteem. But hey, a product that actually works instantly and noticeably comes around... like never. Though, I do love Olay Sensitive Wipes. I've distressed. This scrub is perfect! You don't need much, and it feels amazing. I only use it on my face, as I mentioned expensive. Rinse with cold water, put on some lotion and you'll have an even glow for the rest of the day. I definitely use it in the morning on any "important" days, just to make sure I feel amazing throughout. It's a "must have".

This is one of my favorite Kiehls products, and definitely worth the price! A little goes a long way. I only need it 1-2 times a week, and I can definitely feel a difference – leave my skin is smooth and radiant.

I've tried a few micro-dermabrasion products of different brands and this one by Kiehl's is the best. It's consistently effective, good for even mildly sensitive skin (if you don't overuse it). The product description says up to 3 times a week - I have dry combination skin and I use it about 5 times in every 2 weeks. It prepares the skin for further treatment. My skin always gets a bit "worse" when I slack off or stop using it for a while, so I think this product works pretty well.
Has helped smooth out my skin, also helps minimize my blackheads.

I was looking for a scrub that was a little more (deeper scrub, finer granule, better results) and I have found it with this scrub. I feel that for the price, it is an excellent scrub. I use the Midnight Recovery Concentrate after this...it's perfection. I recommend this to virtually everyone I know. Lovely product.

Every other exfoliator I've used has made my skin red and angry and sometimes leaves my face in pain. Especially during my "lady week", when my skin is at its worst, this stuff really helps scrub away the madness on my face and smooths it out without wrecking my face. I use it about every third day and it has really really helped.

avis.titre: Best scrub for dry sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have very dry skin, which is bumpy in patches, tight at times, and always red. Because of how sensitive it is, I have always stayed away from words like "micro-dermabrasion". But the last time I went to my Kiehl's counter, it was suggested for me to try once week. I was skeptical at first but hooked after my first try! Not only was my skin softer and smoother, it was glowing! It also helped get rid of some of my dry skin cells and I noticed that my moisturizers did their jobs better than before. Because my skin is sensitive, I usually follow with Centella Recovery Skin Salve and that helps to ease any minor irritations.

Really, this is the best scrub for your money. This actually works. You will see results and you will buy this product forever. I have semi sensitive skin, so many scrubs really irritate my face. This does not. Use medium to light pressure, and use 3-4 times a week. I love this stuff!!! Go out today and buy this, seriously.

I had a couple bad experiences with exfoliaters when they left my skin red and tingling. But not this one! The product does great job cleaning and keeps my skin soft and smooth. I use this product weekly on face. Sometimes I splurge and use it on my elbows and knees.

I bought this product on a whim thinking that adding exfoliation to my regime wouldn't hurt. I was thinking of erasing acne scars in the long (or very long) term. Instead, it helped me reduce my acne breakouts significantly. I'd get cysts and whiteheads that are superb obvious and hard to cover with makeup. Now I combine this product along with the blue herbal spot treatment. I also make sure that I'm extra gentle while exfoliating since I've active acne breakouts in the form of whiteheads. I've been struggling with acne for a few years ever since I turned 20, ironically. As an added plus, my face looks brighter and feels softer. No brightening product or moisturizer ever achieved this. Thanks Kiehl's for solving my problems!!!
This product really does destroy dead and nasty skin! I live in a mountainous area, and I love the way that this product helps to protect and nourish my skin!
This has to be the most amazing scrub ever. I honestly think it's the best on the market. The "fine-ness" of the shells is the only scrub that actually works on my dry skin.

This Re-texturizing Micro-Dermabrasion is wonderful. First off, the texture is kind of sandy. It has no particular smell that makes you feel uncomfortable. I used to use it twice a week but realized that once a week is enough. You don't need to apply too much pressure because the tiny sandy texture is really powerful. After rinsing the product off, my skin feels instantly smooth. I love this feeling. However, I have not seen much difference in skin re-texturizing. But this product looks and feels like spa-treatment so definitely I will continue using it to see even better results. Also, healthy diet and some exercise will help make your skin glow and beautiful. Good luck!

avis.titre: One of my favorite Kiehl's products
avis.texte: If used every other day, this product results in more even, brighter skin texture and tone. It keeps winter flakes and un damage at bay.
I've just been to my dermatologist and she commented on how soft and supple my skin was! Love this product, it's my "Special treatment" product!

avis.titre: Such a relief after a long day.
avis.texte: I use this product weekly/bi-weekly to give my face a fresh, revived, clean feeling. The texture is wonderful. You can really feel the granules as you scrub it all over your face. It also has a pleasant, soft smell.

I am pretty picky about exfoliators but decided to try this one after all of the positive reviews and it did not disappoint! It is awesome! It makes my skin ridiculously smooth and it is literally glowing afterwards. The scrub itself is very fine, with an almost sandlike consistency, which I personally prefer. I use this about 3 times a week and have really noticed a difference in my skins texture since doing this. Such a small amount is needed that the tube is definitely a worthwhile investment. I will definitely not be without this!
It is not too harsh. It's just perfect. Eventhough it is a little expencive, it lasts for a very long time.
This is a must have for me. It completely changed my skin. I use it 3 times a week, and it seems to last forever. Totally worth every penny.

avis.titre: HIGHLY Recommended - very gentle yet very effective
avis.texte: I have struggled for years with dry, sensitive skin and large pores. For a large portion of the year I get red, flaky areas under my eyes which I was always self-conscious about. I visited my Kiehl's counter and was introduced to the micro-dermabrasion. I was hesitant at first because I was worried it would be harsh and I have extremely sensitive skin but I gave it a try and it is awesome. I saw immediate improvement in the red, flaky areas under my eyes and after a week they were gone. I have tried many products and this is the only one that, when used consistently, completely gets rid of this problem for me. I also noticed that the dry, flaky skin I tend to get all over in the winter, was corrected with this product. As with all Kiehl's products, I love that you truly only need to use a small amount and it is very effective - one bottle lasts a long time so it is worth it. It is also very gentle on my skin. This past winter I purchased a Clarisonic Mia and have been using that on my face and I have to say that I will be returning to the Kiehl's microdermabrasion - it does a better job in improving my skin texture and appearance of large pores and it less expensive!

Hands down this is my favorite Kiehl's product, completely softens my face has helped to lessen some fine lines and is perfect to help the my skin absorb moisturizer.
